why: The scaffold pins desktop-v3 to the G2 floor, but screens that consume charts GA (analytics and status) need layers frozen later. No screen Issue owns the pin, and the managed layer must be re-rendered at the same version.
what: The basalt-ui pin in apps/desktop-v3/package.json raised from floors.G3.next to floors.G4.next, the lockfile and the re-rendered managed layer. Nothing else.
must_not_touch: application source (a break in ported code is fixed here only when `basalt-ui migrate` rows apply it mechanically; else stop and report a `friction:` line)
contract: Read ~/SourceRoot/basalt-ui/scripts/fleet.json: `floors.G4.next` is the exact version. Pins stay exact. Raised only after v3-freeze-g4. AGENTS.md safety rule 1 (never read /Volumes).
exemplar: The repo's previous bump commit (`git log --oneline -- bun.lock | head`) for message shape.
change: Set `basalt-ui` in apps/desktop-v3/package.json to the floors.G4.next value, `bun install`, run the app bin `sync` and `doctor`, compare `lint --stats` waiver counts before and after. Commit 1: package.json and bun.lock. Commit 2 (only if files change): the re-rendered managed layer. Rule: doctor and lint pass. Skill snippet: none.
commits: Shutterflow ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body.
proof: hygiene.check is false: the gate is the app's typecheck, test and build. This change touches package.json and bun.lock, so `make check-changed` falls back to `make check`: state it not-run.
acceptance: `bun run --filter @shutterflow/desktop-v3 typecheck`, `... test` and `... build` exit 0
app bin `doctor` and `sync --check` exit 0; `lint --stats` waiver count is not higher
`git diff --name-only origin/master...HEAD` lists only owned paths
out_of_scope: Application code, other dependencies, the root install, e2e, src-tauri.
